Basic chat completion via the AWS Bedrock provider using the bedrock/ prefix for routing — verifies the prefix is stripped before dispatching and the Converse API response is normalised to the standard OpenAI chat completion shape

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { Message, createClient } from "@xberg-io/liter-llm";
async function main() {
  const client = createClient("your-api-key");
  const result = await client.chat({ maxTokens: 16, messages: [{ role: "user", user: { content: "Say hello in one word." } } as Message], model: "bedrock/anthropic.claude-3-sonnet-20240229-v1:0", temperature: 0 });
  console.log(result.choices);
  console.log(result.choices?.[0]?.message?.content);
  console.log(result.choices?.[0]?.finishReason);
  console.log(result.model);
  console.log(result.usage?.totalTokens);
}

void main();
```
